title: Balloon flight with private transportation and guided tour to Teotihuacán
overview: Private transportation from Mexico City hotels in Reforma, Roma, Condesa, Polanco, and Centro pairs a 40-to-50-minute shared hot-air balloon flight with a guided visit to the Teotihuacan archaeological zone. Breakfast at a local restaurant, a flight certificate, and a SECTUR-certified Spanish-English guide are included on the eight-hour day.
highlights: Private hotel pickup from central Mexico City districts
Shared hot-air balloon flight over Teotihuacan
Guided visit to the Teotihuacan archaeological zone
Breakfast and flight certificate included
inclusions: 40 to 50 minutes of shared balloon flight
Entrance and guided visit to Teotihuacan
startDescription: Private pickup from accommodations in Paseo de la Reforma, Zona Rosa, Condesa, La Roma, Polanco, Zona Centro, Hipódromo, and Anzures.

title: Balloon Flight + Cave Breakfast + Pick Up from CDMX or We Fly
overview: A shared 30-to-60-minute hot-air balloon flight over Teotihuacan is paired with breakfast at La Cueva Teotihuacán and optional pickup from Mexico City. Certified guiding in the archaeological zone is listed on all-inclusive options, with a meeting point at We Fly Teotihuacan for guests who travel independently.
highlights: Hot-air balloon flight over Teotihuacan
Breakfast at La Cueva Teotihuacán
Optional Mexico City pickup
Guided time in the archaeological zone on all-inclusive options
inclusions: Shared balloon flight from 30 to 60 minutes
Certified guide in the archaeological area on all-inclusive options
startDescription: Hotel pickup from Mexico City when selected, or meet at We Fly Teotihuacan.

title: Private Tour: Xochimilco, Coyoacan and Frida Kahlo Museum
overview: Ride a traditional barge through Xochimilco canals, then visit Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera landmarks on this immersive private tour of Aztec history and Mexico City art. This tour includes round-trip transfers from hotels and vacation rentals across the city and admission to Xochimilco, the Museo Diego Rivera Anahuacalli, and the Frida Kahlo Museum, and features the spectacular mosaic murals at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
highlights: Guided private tour of two of Mexico City's most beloved districts
Ride a traditional boat through the floating gardens of Xochimilco
Private guide reserved for one group
Hassle-free two-way transfers from hotels and rentals across the city
inclusions: Tickets to the Frida Kahlo Museum
startDescription: Hotel or vacation-rental pickup across Mexico City.

title: Pyramids of Teotihuacan Private Tour
overview: A private guide and vehicle cover Teotihuacan from a Mexico City hotel or vacation rental, with snacks, bottled water, and fees included on a five-to-seven-hour outing. The route focuses on the Pyramid of the Sun, Pyramid of the Moon, and the Avenue of the Dead rather than a mixed coach circuit.
highlights: Private Teotihuacan day from Mexico City
Hotel or vacation-rental pickup arranged on request
Snacks and bottled water included
Flexible five-to-seven-hour private pacing
startDescription: Pickup from a Mexico City hotel or listed vacation rental.

title: Full-Day Tour Exploring the Waters of Tolantongo
overview: Indulge in an epic 14- to 16-hour odyssey on this full-day tour of Tolantongo's aquatic wonders. The meticulously planned itinerary is tailored to suit the diverse needs of the modern adventurer. Revel in the tranquility of Tolantongo, where time slows down and each moment is savored at your leisure. With top-notch English-speaking guides, you'll never miss out on a single detail. Plus, comfortable transportation ensures a hassle-free experience with ample space for all.
highlights: Full day exploring the waters of Tolantongo
River relaxation and cave exploration at Grutas Tolantongo
Private transportation from Mexico City
Breakfast and snacks included
inclusions: Sport towel, headlamp, and water bottle
startDescription: Meet along the rotunda facing the Angel of Independence, nearest the Sheraton Mexico City Maria Isabel Hotel.

title: Private Tour: Teotihuacan and Guadalupe Shrine
overview: On this private door-to-door tour, avoid the large tour groups and get to know the sights of Mexico City in the company of just your family and friends. Your personal guide takes you to Tlatelolco, an excavated Aztec zone, and the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe, a popular Catholic pilgrimage site, before you explore the grandiose pyramids and majestic avenues of mysterious Teotihuacan. Upgrade to include lunch.
highlights: See Tlatelolco, an Aztec archaeological site in Mexico City
Visit the Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe
Discover pre-Hispanic pyramids at Teotihuacan
Two-way transfers from Polanco, Condesa, Roma, Centro, Reforma, and Santa Fe
itineraryStops: Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe
startDescription: Hotel pickup from Polanco, Condesa, Roma, Centro, Reforma, and Santa Fe.

title: Frida Kahlo's House, Coyoacan and Xochimilco - All Day Tour
overview: This guided tour to Xochimilco and Casa Azul offers an incredible value for visitors. When you book, not only do you receive entrance fees to both attractions, but you also have transportation in the bag to the far-flung destinations. Plus, your guide is there to answer any questions throughout the day.
highlights: Xochimilco and Casa Azul tour in Mexico City
Visit two essential Mexico City sights with one booking
Entrance fees included
Hotel pickup and drop-off included
inclusions: Hotel pick up and drop off
startDescription: Hotel pickup in Mexico City; pickup time is confirmed by email after booking.

title: Teotihuacan: Pyramids, Caves & Culinary Experience
overview: Take your time to fully explore Teotihuacan on this small-group full-day tour, with convenient round-trip transfer from central Mexico City. Benefit from the knowledge of your guide as you explore landmark structures like the Temple of Quetzalcóatl and the Pyramid of the Sun, then descend underground for an exclusive glimpse of the caves below the ancient city. Round off your trip with a 5-course lunch, followed by optional mezcal and tequila tastings.
highlights: Gain a comprehensive overview of Teotihuacan
Benefit from the local knowledge of your guide
Enjoy the personalized service of a small-group tour
Indulge in a local 5-course lunch, included in the price
inclusions: Round-trip transfer from central Mexico City
startDescription: Round-trip transfer from central Mexico City.

title: Hiking to the Puerta del Cielo Viewpoint in Mexico City
overview: A guided intermediate hike from Mexico City reaches the Puerta del Cielo viewpoint, with a ladder section, canyon overlooks, and a return along a river corridor. Helmet and safety harness, bottled water, and park access fees are included. The group meets at Fuente de Cibeles in Roma Norte beside the CDMX sign.
highlights: Guided hike to Puerta del Cielo from Mexico City
Helmet and safety harness included
Small-group pacing with a local geology-minded guide
Return along a river corridor after the viewpoint
startDescription: Meet at Fuente de Cibeles, Plaza Villa de Madrid, Roma Norte, beside the CDMX sign.

title: The best and most complete PRIVATE CITY TOUR through the Historic Center
overview: A private three-hour walking tour of Mexico City's Centro Histórico starts at the Monument to the Revolution and ends at the Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral on the Zócalo. A local guide covers historic-center streets, plazas, and landmark façades with a group reserved for one party.
highlights: Private historic-center walking tour in Mexico City
Start at the Monument to the Revolution
Finish at the Mexico City Metropolitan Cathedral
Three-hour format for first-time orientation
startDescription: Meet at the intelligent fountain in front of the Monument to the Revolution, Plaza de la República.

title: The Emperor Route, Chapultepec & Paseo de la Reforma Historical bike tour
overview: Explore Mexico City in a unique way by cycling along one of the city's longest dedicated bike lanes, Paseo de la Reforma, and discovering the beauty of Chapultepec Park. With a small group setting, you'll receive personalized attention and enhanced safety. Choose from morning or afternoon departures based on your schedule, and enjoy a delightful street food snack along the way. This tour is perfect for all fitness levels and offers a fun and active way to experience Mexico City.
highlights: Join a small group guided by a local to cycle through the Emperor route
See monuments and sculptures that tell stories of epic battles and legends
Try street food snacks including tacos, chilaquiles, and gorditas
Cycle in Chapultepec Park
startDescription: Meet the cycling guide at the confirmed Mexico City meeting point listed when booking.
